title: Determination 2014/052: wood pellet burner installed in an existing brick chimney, Lumsden (Southland)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004); comparative test only, not Alberta; NZ code references retained as written
code_edition: Building Code (Schedule 1 of the Building Regulations 1992), as cited in the determination's clause note

facts.text: Owners C and H Drummond and Southland District Council (authority), which issued a notice to fix for a wood pellet burner installed into an existing brick chimney at 431 Selbie Road, Lumsden.
The owners obtained building consent BLD/2014/49356/1 for the installation.
The burner is fixed in the chimney cavity with eight rounded spider brackets at 100 mm spacing either side of the flue pipe; the flue height is around 4.5 m.
The manufacturer's instructions in the consent documents specify 300 mm clearance to combustibles above the fire, a 600 mm gap to the ceiling cavity and 100 cm² of cavity ventilation.
The instructions require clearance from the exhaust spigot to combustibles and a 100 mm gap from the rear flue to timber framing; their flue-kit diagrams for masonry chimneys show a bare 75 mm flue.
